principle: Watch what people and public-interest organisations can still act on before the window closes.

families.name: Rights & Money
families.must_know: Changes to benefits, taxes, housing, work, family support and deadlines where late knowledge can cost money or rights.
families.monetisation: Citizen layer free; organisations pay for targeted scopes, workflow integration and measured miss prevention.

families.name: Democracy Action Window
families.must_know: Public hearings, consultations, registration and statement deadlines while influence is still possible.
families.monetisation: High-value NGO monitor: never miss a relevant hearing, consultation or submission window.

families.name: Funding Radar
families.must_know: Relevant grants and calls with eligibility, programme budget and deadlines.
families.monetisation: A single surfaced grant opportunity can justify a full-year subscription; paid value is matching, deadlines, evidence and workflow delivery, not access to public calls.

families.name: Rights & Courts
families.must_know: New judgments that materially change or clarify rights and obligations.
families.monetisation: Organisations pay for topic-specific impact mapping and integration; citizen access stays free.

families.name: Power & Influence
families.must_know: Who is trying to change which rule, which positions are being submitted and which draft or law is affected.
families.monetisation: Paid impact and influence graphs, custom issue scopes, alerts and exports.

families.name: Elections, Petitions & Participation
families.must_know: Election dates, petition signature windows and other concrete participation opportunities.
families.monetisation: Citizen alerts stay free; organisations pay for mission-specific monitoring, outreach timing and integration.

families.name: Promises → Laws → Votes
families.must_know: Track a public promise or proposal through draft, amendment, committee, vote and final law.
families.monetisation: Public accountability is free; organisations pay for custom issue graphs, historical deltas and API delivery.

truth_boundary.note: ACTIVE_CURATED means current records are verified against official sources but harvesting is not yet claimed to be complete or fully autonomous.
